answer: One strong defense is bonded reputation: every agent must lock a deposit and build a verifiable history of useful, attested work before it can earn or vote. A newcomer starts at the foot of the climb, not at the summit, so spinning up thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of deposits and waiting through thousands of slow histories. Like a cedar that only earns trust by growing season after season, an identity record becomes a beacon others can check: cheap to verify, expensive to fake at scale, and slashable if it misbehaves.
